phylogeny_source.expected_role: time-calibrated MCC tree used in the published comparative analyses

trait_source.expected_role: study species and floral anthocyanin information/source

literature_boundary.consequence: Any future result is analysis-prospective but not literature-blinded; published transition results are prior context, not independent surprise.

hierarchy_frozen_before_rows.fine: predominant major anthocyanin class PELARGONIDIN/CYANIDIN/DELPHINIDIN, plus NONE when no anthocyanin is present

grouping.DELPHINIDIN: delphinidin-derived pigments including petunidin and malvidin

hierarchy_frozen_before_rows.if_source_has_published_discrete_predomi: use that source-defined state without recoding beyond the frozen grouping
hierarchy_frozen_before_rows.if_source_has_only_quantitative_proporti: sum within the three frozen major types and use the unique maximum among positive types; total zero -> NONE; exact maximum tie -> HOLD_TIE for that species

hidden_memory_test_if_opportunity.pair_universe: retained unordered pairs sharing the same coarse state
hidden_memory_test_if_opportunity.null: permute fine labels within each coarse group preserving retained fine-state counts
hidden_memory_test_if_opportunity.primary_effect: observed conditional AUC minus permutation-null mean

no_posthoc_rescue: do not substitute visible flower color
do not redefine Pel/Cya/Del grouping after row opening
do not choose a Solanaceae subclade based on the hidden-memory outcome
do not replace TreeBASE S23063 with a different phylogeny after outcome opening
do not change the one-sided P threshold or permutation scheme
relation_to_el_v0_8: Independent future biochemical validation candidate. A PASS can inform a separate promotion audit but does not automatically replace current EL v0.3 or rewrite the frozen Ruellia-specific v0.7 gate.
